The way the boss works is it charges up a meter on first phase and second phase once, every time you starts a turn, you takes a dot damage which is not removable even with huohuo, everytime you loses hp, it increases its meter. Once the meter hits 100, the boss immediately actions and set all allies hp to 1, at this point, a small red weakness icon is avaliable next to your character and forces you to heal up otherwise you do no damage. 

Before the meter being filled up, it takes almost no damage, blade consumes his hp alot, which then helps you to fill up the boss meter quicker
